document.notes: The revision in force for tax year 2025 is Rev. March 2024; irs-prior/f1099k--2025.pdf returns 404. DO NOT take the box numbering from irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1099k.pdf, which serves Rev. December 2026: that revision adds boxes 1c 'Cash tips' and 1d 'TTOC', and moves state income tax withheld from box 8 to box 6. On the TY2025 form box 6 is 'State', box 7 is 'State identification no.' and box 8 is 'State income tax withheld'. Confirmed against Publication 1179 (Rev. Proc. 2025-22), whose exhibit prints 'Form 1099-K (Rev. 3-2024)'. REPORTING THRESHOLD FOR CALENDAR YEAR 2025: a third party settlement organization must file only where the gross amount of reportable payment transactions to a payee EXCEEDS $20,000 AND the number of transactions EXCEEDS 200. The One, Big, Beautiful Bill retroactively reinstated the pre-ARPA threshold; the $5,000/$2,500/$600 phase-in of Notice 2024-85 is superseded. Payment CARD transactions have no de minimis threshold and are reported regardless of amount. NOTE that the instruction set paired with this form revision (i1099k--2024.pdf, Rev. March 2024) still prints the superseded $600 ARPA rule - take the form revision from March 2024 but the threshold from the post-OBBBA guidance. THE THRESHOLD DOES NOT CHANGE TAXABILITY: income is reportable whether or not a Form 1099-K was required or issued, and an amount on a Form 1099-K is not income merely because it was reported. See reportability rule 1099k-threshold-is-not-taxability.
